description: Search facts, transcript passages and topics at once, for clients that only use the generic search/fetch pair (ChatGPT Deep Research). Returns up to 10 ids with a title, link and short snippet; pass an id to fetch for the full text. Other clients should prefer search_facts (quotes with speaker and timestamp) or search_transcripts (raw passages), which page and filter by show.

query.description: Keywords, matched literally (stemmed full-text search, not semantic). Best with 2-4 distinctive words such as names, companies or terms, e.g. "Jensen Huang data centers". Filler and question words are ignored; results matching every keyword come first, then results matching some of them.

name: search
